counterexample_mapping.boundary: the drain keeps the per owner errors of every iteration; one helper returns the complete bundle (final salvage, all salvage, owner errors, attempts, the complete error list, quiescence, proof) and every durable final document of a round unpacks it next to the actual returned state of the public stop, the original failure and the writer diagnostics
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the final recovery could not preserve all cleanup facts: the timeout, the published and the coordination documents exported only the attempts and the proof, so the second owner error and the final resnapshot error never reached the durable evidence

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the terminal document of the not completed barrier carries the actual barrier_persisted, the actual barrier_write_error and the observed snapshot of the barrier, even when they are absent; the status stays FAIL and executed and the name is never relabelled NOT_RUN
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the incomplete barrier terminal rewrite omitted the persistence fields and the exception handler skipped the name because the ledger had already closed it

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the observer and the patch are restored unconditionally, the last release of the gate of the round happens last, a guarded final update closes the durable facts and the evidence with the complete cleanup history and only then the priority is applied: the unwinding original, then the first exact pending interruption, then the ordinary proof
counterexample_mapping.trigger: a late controlled cleanup release appended the exact cancellation after the durable snapshot and the interruption check and the function then returned

counterexample_mapping.boundary: one helper guards the join and the liveness query of one owner and retains the failure with its exact type, its exact detail and the exact object of a cancellation; every owner is attempted, the priority is enforced after the whole traversal and the ordinary proof runs after it; the same repair is applied to the ten audited cleanup regions of the same class
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the deferred cancellation was rethrown inside the startup owner loop and a direct join or query could raise and skip the remaining owners

counterexample_mapping.boundary: every query of the facts of a registry is guarded; the failure is retained with its exact type and detail, the exact object of a cancellation is retained, the snapshot of a failed query is unknown and it is an explicit diagnostic that fails the proof - never a fabricated empty registry
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the post drain registry query could replace the original unwinding or the pending first exact interruption
